module.name: prefer-shortcut-return
module.description: Prefer shortcut boolean returns while preserving comments.

scenarios.name: should allow directly returning the condition expression
scenarios.given: return condition as the final statement of a function
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the return statement

scenarios.name: should allow an if with a non-boolean return in the consequent
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the if statement

scenarios.name: should report if (cond) return true; return false;
scenarios.given: an if statement whose consequent returns true and whose implicit alternative returns false
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the if statement

scenarios.name: should report if (cond) return false; return true;
scenarios.given: an if statement whose consequent returns false and the fallthrough returns true
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the if statement

scenarios.name: should retain comments throughout the complete replacement span
scenarios.given: a comment occurs in the condition, either branch, or between if and trailing return
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the pattern is left unchanged so explanations and tool directives remain intact

scenarios.name: should preserve boolean results for falsy and truthy parameters
scenarios.given: a comment-free conditional returns opposite boolean literals for unknown input
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the fix returns a boolean for undefined, null, zero, empty string, booleans and nonempty values
